goal: Prove the packaged macOS app, rather than a source browser or direct API client, can complete the AI draft review recovery and narrative vertical slice against its own isolated Host and SQLite database.

interaction_boundary.desktop: All create, validation-recovery, choice and rollback actions were real CGEvent mouse interactions in the running Tauri WebView. The Host API and SQLite were only used after actions as state authority/readback.
interaction_boundary.draft_safety: The invalid JSON was rejected before compose; Restore last valid draft restored the Host-validated draft; only the explicit UI confirmation composed the World aggregate.
interaction_boundary.state_authority: The packaged app submits choice IDs and rollback targets. Python persisted every state transition and determined the ending; no command or state JSON was entered by the evaluator.

journey.step: AI draft creation and structured review
journey.result: The packaged creator selected the complete Ollama profile and generated a schema-v3 draft with three chapters, two relationships, routes and endings.
Clearing WorldDefinition and clicking Validate edits produced JSON Parse error: Unexpected EOF. Restore last valid draft returned a valid draft and re-enabled explicit creation.
The packaged UI created World 潮汐之港, WorldVersion 8b5eda13, Hero 林语曦 and Run eba75a36.
The UI selected 援手顾长明, 把证词交给顾长明 and 点亮雾灯. The Host committed revisions 0→1→2→3 and locked the good ending.
The UI chose Restore after turn 2. The Host appended an audit rollback Turn 4 (revision 3→4) and restored the pre-ending state: chapter ch3 active, route lan-route locked, ending null.

Only the packaged desktop process and its sidecar were stopped. The same .app relaunched against the same isolated data directory; /health succeeded and the WebView reopened Run eba75a36 at revision 4 with the post-rollback state.

limits: This is a debug-signed macOS bundle, not a notarized release artifact or Windows desktop acceptance.

The model-profile probe had packaged UI evidence, but the healthy Ollama profile was seeded in the isolated Host before this run; this is not evidence that a user created that profile through the packaged settings form.
This evidence does not replace Android physical-device validation, LAN discovery/pairing or a real-model long-play quality assessment.
